name: pod-design-system-test
description: Small design system test environment for POD — sprint-style scope.

scripts.build:docs: pnpm build:packages && mkdir -p apps/docs/public && echo '{"drifted":[],"inSync":[],"errors":[]}' > apps/docs/public/figma-status.json && echo '{"components":[]}' > apps/docs/public/figma-manifest.json && pnpm -F docs build
scripts.build:centernode: pnpm build:packages && cd centernode && npm install --no-fund --no-audit && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client-test && npm install --no-fund --no-audit && npm run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:docs && pnpm build:centernode && pnpm build:client
